source.method: Original captured WEBP frames composited with source kit masks and origin coordinates

adaptation: Original national-color palettes applied only through source-authored shirt, shorts and stripe masks; source bodies, faces, frame coordinates and native holds remain unchanged. Masks are RGB coverage fields, not new character artwork.
athletes: Generic fictional athletes; no real-player likeness
flags: Original simplified vector flag icons in flag.tsx
trophy: Original SVG design in views.tsx; original CSS stadium presentation and SVG menu symbols in menu.module.css and menu-icons.tsx
music: Original procedural 112 BPM stadium composition in src/features/games/penalty-cup/music.ts: synthesized percussion, bass, chords and alternating melodic phrases. No third-party recordings or compositions. Generated locally through WebAudio, no runtime downloads.
font: Barlow Condensed, SIL OFL 1.1; copied from maintained vendor/final-third
